name: station-crest.c2-try2
prompt:
Premium science-fiction game interface art for Last Line: dark smoked glass over graphite steel, fine white-gold filigree lines, thin constellation lines and small glyph marks at the corners, electric cyan and orange-gold light accents, a faint inner glow. Crisp, finished and richly detailed like the interface of a top commercial sci-fi action game, with clean bevels and sharp edges, readable at small size. Shown flat and straight on, no perspective, no scenery. No text, letters, numbers, signature or watermark.

KIND — ICON: A single standalone painted raster HUD icon. One bold coherent silhouette with broad luminous material faces and restrained detail, legible at 20 pixels. Actual crafted object, dimensional bevels and subtle material wear, front view. The requested hardware housing or physical crest belongs to the subject; keep the exterior canvas empty. No writing, letters, digits, logos or watermark. Square 1024 x 1024 canvas. The complete subject including attached accents spans 70 percent of the canvas on its longest side and is precisely centred, with at least 15 percent clear margin on every side. Hard clean cutout contour, opaque solid object and crisp contained light; generous open negative spaces between separate features. Bright ivory-white-gold faces and cyan signal details against graphite recesses give strong small-size luminance contrast. Use just enough filigree to match the premium Lightbearer UI; group it into a few large readable shapes.

Subject: Station crest. A solid HEATER SHIELD medallion, strongly recognisable shield silhouette: broad flat horizontal top with two pronounced squared shoulder corners, tapering curved sides converging to a long deep central point at the bottom. The shield is about 75 percent as wide as it is tall. Thick bevelled ivory-white-gold metal rim, fully filled graphite-steel interior. A single compact station watchtower is embossed inside the shield, broad ivory tower with a central large cyan reactor window and squat platform. One strong tower, centred, entirely within the shield. The lower pointed third is solid gold and graphite; the top third has a broad horizontal cap. Large opaque material faces, contained cyan light, sparse tiny engraving. Readable as a shield bearing a station at 20 pixels. Keep the outer silhouette entirely shield-shaped and distinct from a hexagonal hazard badge or free-standing twin towers. Premium dimensional metallic craft.

Background: genuine transparent RGBA, crisp opaque hardware, centred on 1024 square, longest side 70 percent. Clear transparent outer margins. Orthographic front view.
